skill.ton618.ton_618.last_light.desc: Only in the dark, after TON 618 has devoured the world. Let time go: the stars burn out, the eras pass, and after a googol of years TON618 has evaporated away by Hawking radiation. Its last light brings the world back, on a new morning, for everyone in the dark.
